easy.text: Ticket: `slugify(title)` in `ledger/text.py` must return the title in lower case, with leading and trailing spaces removed and every run of spaces replaced by one hyphen. The tests in `tests/test_text.py` describe the behaviour. Make them pass. Do not edit anything under `tests/`. Check with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.

hard.text: Ticket: amounts in our files are written five different ways: `1,234.50` (thousands comma), `-12.00` (minus sign), `€3` (euro sign, whole euros), `(45.10)` (brackets mean negative, accounting style) and `12` (whole number). `parse_amount(text)` in `ledger/money.py` must return the exact amount in cents as an int for all five, ignore surrounding spaces, and raise `ValueError` for anything else, including more than two decimals and an empty string. `monthly_totals(rows)` in `ledger/report.py` must accept dates as `2026-03-14` or `14/03/2026`, total amounts by month as `"YYYY-MM"` keys, and raise `ValueError` naming the row number (counting from 1) when a row's amount is invalid. The tests in `tests/test_money.py` and `tests/test_report.py` describe the behaviour. Make them pass. Do not edit anything under `tests/`. Check with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .`.

big.command: codex exec -m <model_id> -c model_reasoning_effort="<reasoning>" --sandbox workspace-write --skip-git-repo-check --json "<ticket text>" (subprocess timeout 1200 s)
